scope: Recorded Mississippi MnCAV steering-curvature equivalence, not a measured road-wheel or INS mounting calibration.
method: Fit steering_curvature = tan((steering_wheel_angle_rad - offset)/16.2)/3.089 using bag-time-paired topics. Fit 1.503989 degrees; round to 1.5 degrees. Validated on later calibration samples and the separate 12:09:31 drive.
